Reason for change: Let the top layers adapt to review-specific wording such as product complaints and mixed praise and criticism

Change made: Lower the learning rate from 2e-4 to 5e-5
Reason for change: 5e-5 is a common transformer fine-tuning rate; tests whether the baseline rate is too aggressive
Expected result: Similar or slightly better results with smoother loss curves
Practical trade-off: Same cost as the baseline; may need more epochs to converge (0.59M trainable weights, 3.7 min)

Change made: Raise the maximum input length from 128 to 256 tokens
Reason for change: Reviews longer than 128 tokens are cut off, and a complaint may appear late in a review
Expected result: Small gain, limited by how many reviews exceed 128 tokens (Section 3.1)
Practical trade-off: Longer inputs cost more compute in training and in every prediction (0.59M trainable weights, 4.6 min)
